LG has responded to our deep-dive investigation revealing the depths of LG Smart TV ACR data harvesting functionality, LG's claims to "owning the glass," and LG Smart TV security vulnerabilities and exploits. When LG responded to GamersNexus, it called our report untrue and, essentially, claimed the "fake news" defense. We believe the company failed to present a single point of evidence to counter our findings. In this video, we dismantle LG's response and bring in lawyer Vincent Agosta to analyze their terms so that consumers understand what they're agreeing to.
